text.p: Demand for the share issue of Fakto, Estonia's Nissan dealer, doubled the supply, Balti Cresco said on Tuesday.
Fakto issued 444,588 shares and investors subscribed for 882,260 shares, Indrek Rahumaa, Balti Cresco's head of corporate finance, told Reuters.
The stake of Estonian and foreign investors was equal, Rahumaa added.
The results of the share issue, which was closed on Monday, will be approved on Friday, he said.
The price of a 10 kroon share was 28 kroons. The issue increases the company's equity to 14.7 million kroons.
Fakto has also submitted an application to list its shares on the Tallinn bourse.
Fakto had a net profit of 1.56 million kroons and a turnover of 146 million kroons in 1996.
